research_question: Under a bimodal and heavy-tailed inter-burst gap schedule (30-1500 ms gaps), does the calibrated ski-rental break-even threshold tau* = 250 ms achieve an empirical competitive ratio <= 2.0 against an offline clairvoyant oracle while strictly beating tau=0 (explicit) and tau=inf (retain)?
hypothesis: pool_auto at tau* = 250 ms avoids refaults on sub-threshold gaps (<250 ms) while reclaiming long idle gaps (>=250 ms), achieving competitive ratio <= 2.0 and lower total ski-rental cost than both tau=0 and tau=inf with max_abs_error == 0.
acceptance_gates: 1) max_abs_error == 0 across all 40 runs; 2) empirical competitive ratio ALG(250 ms)/OPT <= 2.0; 3) ALG(250 ms) < ALG(tau=0) and ALG(250 ms) < ALG(tau=inf); 4) validate_run.py --require-protocol --min-trials 5 passes.
